verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Group net turnover decreased 4% to EUR 25.99 million with a loss of EUR 643,000 (compared to EUR 2.37 million loss prior year). Parent company net turnover decreased 6% to EUR 21.92 million with a loss of EUR 552,000 (compared to EUR 1.34 million loss prior year).

candidate_sentences.text: For the financial year ended June 30, 2025, AS SAF Tehnika and its subsidiaries reported a consolidated net turnover of 25.99 million euros, representing a decrease of 1.1 million euros or 4% compared to the previous financial year 2023/2024.
The parent company reported a net turnover of 21.92 million euros, which is 1.33 million euros or 6% lower than the 23.25 million euros reported in the preceding financial year.
The group concluded the 2024/2025 financial year with a consolidated net loss of 642.6 thousand euros, and basic and diluted loss per share of 0.216 euros.
This represents an improvement compared to the previous financial year, when the group reported a net loss of 2.37 million euros and a loss per share of 0.798 euros.
The parent company reported a net loss of 551.8 thousand euros for the reporting period, compared to a net loss of 1.34 million euros in the previous financial year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Regional revenue changes: Americas region turnover decreased 14% to EUR 14.17 million (55% of group turnover), Europe region turnover increased 17% to EUR 10.0 million, Asia/TMiddle East/Africa region turnover decreased 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

candidate_sentences.text: Regionally, turnover in the Americas, encompassing North, South, and Central America, was 14.17 million euros, representing 55% of the total group turnover and marking a decrease of 2.3 million euros or 14% compared to the 2023/2024 financial year.
Conversely, turnover in the European region, including Latvia, increased by 1.4 million euros or 17%, reaching 10.0 million euros.
Revenue in the Asia, Middle East, and Africa regions decreased by 90 thousand euros or 5%, amounting to 1.8 million euros.
